summary: A Jeddah polyclinic open 24 hours appears to lose patients because its page still shows template placeholder articles, template events and a free builder footer from 2019.

findings.problem: The Media Center appears to show three articles that still carry the template text This is your News Article. Whether you have got new treatments available...
findings.cost: A patient who reads template instructions on a medical site doubts that anyone looks after the clinic, and a clinic that looks unattended loses the booking.
findings.fix: Remove placeholders and publish real news or leave them out.

findings.problem: The Upcoming Events block appears to list three events in San Francisco, and a BandsInTown and an Instagram block appear with no content.
findings.cost: Events in another city on a Jeddah clinic page confuse patients and make the clinic look unfinished.

findings.problem: The page appears to run on a free Wix address with a Wix banner, and the footer appears to say 2019 by First Future Medical Complex.
findings.cost: A 2019 date and a builder advert make a 24 hour polyclinic look inactive, and families choose a clinic that looks current.
findings.fix: Your own domain and a current footer.

findings.problem: The contact appears to be a gmail address and one phone number, with no WhatsApp button.
findings.cost: Patients in Jeddah message first, and a clinic that cannot be messaged in one tap loses them.
findings.fix: A one tap WhatsApp button next to Book Online.
